description.value:
Once on each of your turns, when you make a ranged weapon attack against a creature, you can make the attack pierce through multiple creatures. Make an attack roll with disadvantage against each creature in a line directly behind the original target, until you miss, hit an object, or reach the normal range of your weapon, whichever comes first.

The piercing attacks do not benefit from effects that give you advantage, or cancel disadvantage. However, if used with your @UUID[Compendium.wc5e-foundryvtt.class-features.Item.GwjGQzliLe6NuYBW]{Lone Wolf: Aimed Attack} feature, the attacks are no longer made with disadvantage.
